title: Stress Testing from Geotechnical Engineering: Probing LLM Safety Under Extreme Input Conditions

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Identifying the failure envelope under extreme inputs is useful for hardening models, but the causal chain from edge-case characterization to safety improvement is incremental rather than fundamental.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Generating extreme inputs (long contexts, unicode, mixed scripts) and measuring safety degradation via API is straightforward. Parameterized test suites are standard software engineering. Beginner-friendly.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Testing multiple stress dimensions independently and in combination could expand quickly. Needs to be limited to 3-4 dimensions to fit 30 hours, but the combinatorial nature risks scope creep.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
